races.title: State House, District 75
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Donny C. Lambeth
cands.bio: Republican state representative for North Carolina House District 75 (Forsyth County) since 2013. Hospital CEO with about 40 years in health care. Chaired the Winston-Salem/Forsyth County Board of Education for 18 years. Senior chair of House Appropriations and chair of the Health Committee.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Lambeth was born or raised, or when he came to North Carolina. We found no documented actions or stated positions from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buying, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, police pay and public order, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. We found no statements from him about data centers or development. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for his 2026 race. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2020, 2022, 2024 or 2026. No controversies or foreign ties turned up in the pages we had. His campaign site describes his background and accomplishments, and we could not confirm those claims, including his school board service and awards, against independent sources.

qual.background: Served in the NC House from 2013 and was on the Speaker's leadership team. Was a hospital CEO in a roughly 40-year health care career, and chaired the Winston-Salem/Forsyth County school board for 18 years. Holds a BS from High Point University and an MBA from Wake Forest University.
qual.why: Thirteen years in the legislature and leadership service, plus a management and budget-relevant career as a hospital CEO with an MBA, and long elected local office. Committee chairmanships were not counted toward the score. The school board, career and education details come from his campaign site, so they are self-reported.

cands.name: Jen Wiles
cands.bio: Winston-Salem Democrat and healthcare clinician with more than 20 years in healthcare, including a decade in emergency medicine, trauma and acute surgical services. Now works on digital health solutions. Mother of two. Won NC House District 75 in 2026, defeating incumbent Donny Lambeth. No prior elected office found.

endorsements.text: Progressive Caucus of the North Carolina Democratic Party
NC Public School Champions (Sway voting group)

cands.gaps: We could not find where Jen Wiles was born or when she came to or lived in North Carolina as an adult beyond her upbringing in Davidson County. We found no record of prior elected office. We found no documented actions in office on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, policing, guns or abortion. Her campaign site links to plans on taxes, energy, data centers, cannabis and community safety, but we could not read those plans, so we cannot report what they say. Her stated positions on those topics are not documented in the pages we reviewed, and she has not publicly pledged to refuse any category of donor money.
